name: AiAnswerContent
texts: Start Bijan Robinson over Kenneth WalkerRobinson is the clear start this week. Atlanta has run 61% of theirfirst-half plays out of 11 personnel, and Robinson is on the field for 88% ofthem.Volume — 19.4 touches per game, third among RBs since Week 4.Matchup — Carolina is allowing 4.9 yards per carry to the left side.Game script — Atlanta is favored by 6.5, which keeps the run rate high.Walker is not a bad play. He is a worse play, and only because Seattle islikely trailing by two scores in the second half.Robinson projects at 18.2 points against Walker's 13.6. That gap iswider than it looks: Walker's floor collapses in negative game script.
Yes — drop Gus Edwards. He is behind two backs on the depthchart and has not seen a red-zone carry since Week 3. Prefer any startingreceiver on your waiver list.
